excerpt: Whitewater between limestone canyons in the Huasteca Potosina: what Tampaón River rafting costs in 2026, how to get there from Ciudad Valles and the best season to go.
contentHtml:
Rafting the Tampaón River is the most exciting whitewater run in the Huasteca Potosina, a trip of several hours between limestone walls and tropical vegetation that few rivers in Mexico can match. Many travelers arrive in Ciudad Valles without knowing exactly how to set up this tour, how much it costs or which months are safe to do it; that uncertainty ends here. This guide covers everything you need to go rafting on the Tampaón River safely and with a solid plan in 2026.

In the sections below you'll find up-to-date prices, departure times, Huasteca Potosina rafting options with verified operators and practical tips on gear and season. According to local operators in the region, the Tampaón gets more than 8,000 visitors during the high season between October and March 2026, which makes it one of the most visited adventure rivers in San Luis Potosí.

At huasteca-potosina.com we work with local guides and operators in the region. This guide is updated with real experiences from people who travel the Huasteca Potosina every week. Last updated: September 2026. Before you book, book your guided tour in the Huasteca Potosina to make the most of every day of your visit.

How do you get to the Tampaón River from Ciudad Valles for rafting?

Route and distance from Ciudad Valles to Tanchachín

From Ciudad Valles, take Highway 70 for about 30 km to the community of Tanchachín, the usual put-in point for a Tampaón River tour. The drive takes around 40 minutes. Operators that provide transportation leave Ciudad Valles at 9:00 a.m. and reach the river at about 10:30 a.m. Book Rafting on the Tampaón River with transportation included to keep your logistics simple.

Operating days and hours in 2026

The tour runs every day with a minimum of 4 people per group. The run ends at around 3:00 p.m., with a meal included in most packages, and you're back in Ciudad Valles by about 5:30 p.m. If you're going to combine this activity with other routes, see our guide to the 3-day Huasteca Potosina itinerary.

Tampaón River rafting prices and options in 2026

How much does Tampaón River rafting cost in 2026?

Our Rafting on the Tampaón River tour costs $1,950 MXN per person and includes pickup from your lodging in Xilitla or Ciudad Valles, a meal, full gear, a certified whitewater guide and insurance; it lasts about 7 hours. If you'd rather get to Tanchachín on your own, you can hire local boats for $700 to $1,000 MXN per boat, with room for up to 8 people. Tips before rafting the Tampaón River: what to bring and how to prepare

  • Pick the right season: The ideal season for Tampaón River rafting is October to March. Between July and September, rain can raise the water level and lead to last-minute cancellations.
  • The right clothes and shoes: Wear quick-dry synthetic clothing and sandals with good grip or water shoes. Avoid cotton; it holds moisture and leaves you cold on the river. Also see our guide to the best time to visit the Huasteca Potosina.
  • Water-resistant sun protection: Apply water-resistant SPF 50+ sunscreen before you leave and bring an extra bottle in a dry bag.
  • Book ahead in high season: Small-group spots on long weekends and over the December holidays sell out 2 to 3 weeks in advance in 2026.

Frequently asked questions about Tampaón River rafting

Do you need to know how to swim to go rafting on the Tampaón River?

Knowing how to swim isn't required, but basic confidence in the water is recommended. All participants wear a life jacket and helmet provided by the operator. Certified guides are with you for the entire run. In 2026, all verified operators require full use of safety gear.

How much does rafting on the Tampaón River cost in 2026?

With us it costs $1,950 MXN per person, with pickup from your lodging in Xilitla or Ciudad Valles, gear, a certified guide, a meal and insurance. Going on your own and hiring a local boat in Tanchachín costs $700 to $1,000 MXN per boat.

What's the best time of year to raft the Tampaón River?

The ideal season is October to March, when the water flow is steady and the weather is cool. Between July and September, heavy rain can shut down the activity for safety reasons. The drive from Ciudad Valles is about 30 km on Highway 70, roughly 40 minutes by car.

Is rafting on the Tampaón suitable for families or couples with no experience?

Yes. Huasteca Potosina rafting on the Tampaón has stretches suitable for beginners and for families with kids ages 10 and up, depending on the operator. Local companies adapt the route to the group. We recommend letting them know when you book if there are kids, older adults or first-timers in your group so they can assign the right guides.
